caption: A cold pane of glass is held over a steaming kettle, and it fogs and then drips from its lower edge.

sa.check: A pane of glass is held over a steaming kettle.
Drops drip from its lower edge.
The top face of the pane stays dry.
The fogging comes first and the dripping follows.

pc.expect: The drops on the underside run to the pane's lowest edge and fall from there straight down.
pc.fail: Drops run up the pane's underside; or drops fall upward off the pane; or drops stay fixed on a steeply tilted pane; or drops gather along the pane's highest edge and drip from there.

pc.expect: The fogging and the beading only build while the steam keeps reaching the pane, and the drops only gather and fall.
pc.fail: The pane's underside dries while steam still reaches it; or the drops shrink and grow in turn; or the pane is wet before any steam reaches it; or a drop that has fallen returns to the pane.

pc.expect: The fog and the drops are on the face toward the steam and the top face stays dry.
pc.fail: The top face fogs while the underside stays dry; or both faces fog equally; or the pane fogs in a part the steam never reaches; or the steam plays on the pane and it stays clear and dry to the end of the clip.

pc.expect: The drops behave as water on glass: rounded, merging when they touch and running as streaks, and the pane stays rigid and clear.
pc.fail: Touching drops overlap without merging; or drops jump about on the pane; or the water sets as frost over a steaming kettle; or the pane flexes as the water runs.

pc.expect: One pane and one kettle; the drops come from the steam and leave only by falling.
pc.fail: A drop vanishes in mid-air; or drops appear on the top face with none crossing the edge; or the pane passes through the kettle; or a second pane appears.

pc.expect: The kettle, the pane's edges and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The kettle changes colour; or the pane changes size; or items around the kettle rearrange.

note: Whoever holds the pane is not judged.
